subject.title: feat(gateway): utility-model auto-titles for sessions beyond dashboard

question: Should non-dashboard sessions receive automatic LLM-generated titles by default, or only when utility-model use has been explicitly configured for the agent?
rationale: This changes the default number and destination of model requests for existing channel sessions and may send first-message content to a provider other than the primary provider; code inspection cannot determine the intended cost and privacy policy.

options.title: Require explicit utility configuration
options.body: Generate non-dashboard titles only when `utilityModel` is explicitly set to a non-empty model, preserving current behavior for unset configurations.

options.title: Approve automatic provider defaults
options.body: Allow unset `utilityModel` to use the provider-declared small model for every eligible first turn, with documented cost, privacy, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep dashboard-only titles
options.body: Close or narrow this PR and retain automatic model-generated titles only for the existing dashboard workflow.

recommendation.title: Require explicit utility configuration
recommendation.body: Generate non-dashboard titles only when `utilityModel` is explicitly set to a non-empty model, preserving current behavior for unset configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers the reply pipeline, inbound context, and security-sensitive routing decisions affected by this default.
